user.title: Connect HA Monitor
user.description: Enter the HTTPS base URL of your Laravel server and a new pairing code from its instance page. Codes expire after ten minutes and can be used once. If a response is lost, create a new code before trying again.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect HA Monitor
reauth_confirm.description: The agent token was revoked or is invalid. Create a new pairing code for the same instance in Laravel, then enter it here. Issuing a code immediately invalidates the previous token.

reconfigure.title: Change receiver or pair again
reconfigure.description: Enter the receiver URL and a new pairing code for the same instance UUID. To connect a different instance, add a separate integration. Pairing consumes the code even if its instance does not match.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment. A path prefix is supported.
error.invalid_code: The pairing code must contain exactly 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_auth: The code is invalid, expired, already used, or its instance is disabled. Create a new code in Laravel.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the receiver. Check the address and network. If the code may have been consumed, create a new one.
error.server_error: The receiver reported a temporary error. If the code may have been consumed, create a new one before trying again.
error.rate_limited: The receiver is rate limiting requests. Wait at least {retry_after} seconds before trying again.
error.tls_error: TLS certificate verification failed. Correct the receiver's certificate, certificate chain, hostname or trusted CA configuration.
error.forbidden: The receiver refused this request. Check its HTTPS ingress, trusted proxy configuration and instance configuration.
error.invalid_response: The receiver returned an incompatible or incomplete response. Check that it implements protocol v1. If pairing consumed the code, create a new one.
error.protocol_error: The receiver rejected this request. Check the server URL, protocol version and receiver configuration. Create a new code if needed.

abort.already_configured: This instance is already configured. Use Reconfigure to pair it again.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The code belongs to a different instance. The existing entry was left unchanged. Create a new code for the correct instance; the submitted code has been consumed.

init.title: Monitoring and transmission
init.description: Monitoring Snapshot v2 transmits all discovered update sources by default, including hidden sources and updates installed outside Home Assistant. Failed sources produce partial coverage while known updates are still transmitted. Original versions, categories and the allowed source/device metadata are included. Explicitly saved source restrictions remain in effect. Disable all-source transmission to export only Core/OS and selected sources. Monitoring transmission is initially off; local collection continues when uploads are paused. Changes reload the integration and discard retry buffers. Collection runs on the agent’s own 60-second clock, independently of Home Assistant entity polling. Health v1 is separately opt-in and reports every five minutes. Select approved domains and entities; all-entity export and device associations require separate choices. Health waits until HA has fully started. Names require separate approval; use reviewed labels without credentials only. Current backup status remains unknown until a full native lifecycle has been observed. Confirmed earlier observations remain local historical diagnostics only.

data.health_enabled: Enable Health v1 collection and transmission
data.health_sections: Health domains to collect and transmit
data.health_devices: Associate entities with local device IDs (for device ignores)
data.health_names: Transmit reviewed integration, entity and device names

data_description.health_devices: Includes stable local device IDs for reported entities. No hardware identifiers or device-outage assertion. Device names also require name approval.
data_description.health_names: Off by default. Approves config-entry titles and entity/device registry names. Labels can contain private details: review them and remove credentials before enabling. No HA state attributes or repair text.

invalid_auth.message: The HA Monitor agent token is invalid or revoked. Pair this instance again with a new code.

upload_blocked.title: HA Monitor uploads have stopped
upload_blocked.description: The receiver or local payload failed a permanent check: {reason}. No unchanged uploads will be retried. Check the receiver's protocol v1 compatibility, instance UUID, HTTPS ingress, certificate chain and system clocks. For HTTP 400/413/415/422, correct the receiver/payload compatibility; for 403, correct ingress or instance configuration. Correct the cause, then reload the integration. Use Reconfigure with a new pairing code if the receiver URL or credentials changed. TLS certificate verification cannot be disabled.

monitoring_blocked.title: HA Monitor monitoring uploads stopped
monitoring_blocked.description: Monitoring Snapshot v2 upload failed: {reason}. A payload_too_large collection exceeds 2 MiB; the previous server projection is retained. Reduce the export scope or metadata size and reload. HTTP 404 means the v2 endpoint is absent; 409 means a snapshot ID was reused with changed content. Correct compatibility, HTTPS or clock settings, then reload. Local collection and heartbeats continue independently. For HTTP 422, the reason includes rejected schema field paths when supplied by the receiver. Diagnostics also show these paths without response messages or source values.

update_export_incomplete.title: HA Monitor update transmission is limited
update_export_incomplete.description: Some sources were omitted by the export selection or could not be collected completely. Known offered updates outside the selection: {omitted}. Reason: {reason}. Check the source selection and availability under Settings → Devices & services → HA Monitor → Configure. Snapshot v2 transmits known records with partial coverage; their offered count is a lower bound. Local collection and heartbeats continue.

health_blocked.title: Health report transmission stopped
health_blocked.description: The receiver rejected Health v1 transmission ({reason}). Correct the receiver or configuration and reload the integration. Heartbeats and monitoring snapshots run independently.
